title: FBI says Artex AI open source hacking tool used to breach networks in ‘under three hours’
slides: FBI flags Artex AI: why three hours to breach?

thread_text:
1. FBI flags Artex AI

The FBI says Artex AI breached a network in three hours. The tool is open source, and it targets exposed edge devices — no phishing required.

2. Open source attack tool

Artex AI scans for network edge devices left exposed online. It finds them, then breaches them — all without a human clicking anything.

3. Phishing is now optional

Attackers don't need to trick employees anymore. Artex AI bypasses the human entirely and goes straight for your perimeter gear.

4. You may already be scanned

If your edge devices are exposed, Artex AI may have already probed them. The tool is public, and the scanning is automated.

5. Audit before Artex does

Check your exposed network gear today. Run a scan of your perimeter and close any open doors before Artex AI finds them first.
